0.original: Qhoterl Pasol would set history right once and for all.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

1.original: Deliver the requested supplies to Qhoterl Pasol.

48.original: Thanks to your tireless efforts, our excavation is nearing its completion. The gifts of the past we've uncovered here will be a boon to future Qitari, to be sure, but we mustn't keep our discoveries to ourselves. No, I intend to spread knowledge of Ronka to every corner of the world!

49.original: To that end, I mean to author a definitive history of Ronka with my own hands. Moreover, I intend to use an ingenious system of woodblocks and ink to produce enough copies so that no curious mind goes unsated.

50.original: If you would be an ally of history, then I have just the task for you. Pray bring me a slab of black stone from Mjrl's Regret. While it may appear a common stone at first glance, we have long used it to make writing instruments.

51.original: If you would be an ally of history, then I have just the task for you. Pray bring me hemp from Mjrl's Regret. I can't start writing without paper, and the material made from this hemp is as sturdy as it comes.

52.original: If you would be an ally of history, then I have just the task for you. Pray return with a mammoth shellfish from the depths of Lake Tusi Mek'ta. Though they may be tricky to snag with your spear, their sacs contain enough ink to fill countless inkwells.

53.original: The world is eager to learn the truth of Ronka. Return here with the black stone and I shall begin writing at once!

54.original: The world is eager to learn the truth of Ronka. Return here with the hemp and I shall begin writing at once!

55.original: The world is eager to learn the truth of Ronka. Return here with the shellfish and I shall begin writing at once!

56.original: In order to proceed with this quest, you must first complete the quest “A New Fishing Ex-spear-ience” and unlock spearfishing.

57.original: I am always glad to see you, and now more than ever! Have you brought the materials I requested?

58.original: Splendid, as always! I eventually hope to distribute my chronicle throughout Norvrandt, although it would be prudent to begin with a smaller proving ground, such as the Greatwood. Assuming I meet with success here, my ambitions know no bounds!

59.original: A Steward can ask for no greater honor than this task I've given myself, and I shan't rest until I see it done!
